reference_screenshot.description: A compact horizontal capsule switch with four equal time-of-day scenes and a separate glossy circular selection lens that travels between the four positions. The direction combines Windows XP control depth, pixel-art scenery, and Y2K gloss.

generated_assets.prompt_summary: Edit the existing four-zone capsule into a richer production pixel-art panorama while preserving the four equal morning, noon, sunset, and night cells. Add layered clouds, rays, reflected water, atmospheric depth, varied night stars, and a softly dimensional ivory/champagne rim, keeping the compact Windows XP and Y2K character legible at 176 CSS pixels. A second image-generation edit preserved the artwork while placing the complete pill on a flat green chroma-key exterior and removing presentation margins.
mechanical_processing: Removed the generated flat green exterior with the installed imagegen chroma-key helper using a soft matte and despill, preserving the four generated scenes and metallic border.
Cropped to the generated alpha bounds, resized to 880 by 192 pixels, preserved RGBA transparency, and losslessly optimized the final PNG.
No visual content was drawn in code; post-processing was limited to background removal, cropping, resizing, and PNG optimization.
